title: Recent on ui-entry-wt uses the shared filmstrip
goal: One page still lists recent captures in an older one-off layout, so the same thing looks and behaves differently depending on where you meet it. This moves it to the shared layout and removes the leftover styling nothing else uses.
notes: home.html's Recent grid is now the shared .filmstrip / .filmcard, so the landing window and the history overlay agree on what a capture looks like and what you can do to one. ui-entry-wt.html is the last page still drawing the old bespoke .recents / .rec grid. Port it, then delete .recents / .rec / .rec .pv / .rec .cap from shared/components/inspector.css (lines ~48-51) since nothing will use them.
acceptance: Recent captures on that page look and behave the same as they do on the landing screen
The retired one-off styling is deleted from the shared stylesheet and nothing else refers to it
The page loads without error and passes the automated page sweep

log.note: adversarial review (before): the mock's own instruction was to copy home.html wholesale, including its pre-selected first card. Rejected that one detail. home.html pre-selects to SHOW the action row; ui-entry-wt is a walkthrough whose step 3 target is the Design UI tile, and a card sitting there pre-selected with a four-button action row is a second bright focal point competing with the cue, and it is false state besides: the front door has only just opened and the person has picked nothing. Ported the shape, not the selection. Clicking any card still selects it and reveals the same actions, so behaviour matches.
also cut the two local overrides (#homeWin .recents 3-col, .rec .pv 64px). The shared filmstrip is a scrolling flex row, so it needs no local geometry at all, which is the point of the port.

shared CSS: deleted .recents/.rec/.rec .pv/.rec .cap from shared/components/inspector.css and rebuilt shared/dist/photonz-ds.css via shared/build-ds.mjs (the dist bundle is generated, so deleting the source rule alone would have left it live).

grep note for whoever finds the leftover hits: docs/design/mocks/creation-vision.html still uses .recents/.rec, but it is the original single-file vision study that carries its own tokens and never links the shared stylesheet, so it is self-contained and out of this corpus. Nothing that loads photonz-ds.css refers to the retired names.

verified in the real browser, not by grep. On step 2 the three cards measure 152x126 with an 82px thumb, identical to home.html; selecting one grows it to 163 and shows the same four actions (copy, edit, pin, delete); selection is exclusive; the video card carries the play badge and 0:15; the strip fits the 640px window (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 590) and the window stays inside the desk even when the action row expands it (672 of 724).

gates: check-selection, check-states, check-elevation all pass. The browser sweep (shared/audit-sweep.js) ran over all 90 pages in four chunks and reported zero issues. Page returns 200 with no console errors beyond a pre-existing favicon 404.

adversarial review (after): the strip is left-aligned with three cards and empty space to its right where the old 3-column grid stretched edge to edge. That is correct, not a regression: it is exactly what the landing window does, and it is the visual promise that more captures scroll in from the right. The one thing I could not fix is shared: the action buttons' title attributes are stripped by the icon-button pass, so they have neither title nor aria-label. home.html has the identical defect, so it is pre-existing and corpus-wide rather than something this port introduced. Not filing it as a task for this cycle since it belongs to whoever owns the icon-button pass.
